Such decision shall be supported by appropriate reasons recorded on file. The Vidyalaya also reserves the right to postpone, modify or withdraw the tender, or amend any terms and conditions through a corrigendum on the GeM portal, wherever considered necessary in the public interest or due to administrative or technical reasons. No bidder shall have any claim for compensation, loss of profit or damages on account of such cancellation or modification. After award of contract, cancellation or termination shall be governed by the termination provisions of the contract and applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions.

TERMINATION OF CONTRACT The Principal, PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya OF Bhandara, reserves the right to terminate the contract, wholl y or partially, by giving 30 days' written notice, in the administrative interest of the Vidyalaya or due to an y other valid reason, in accordance with the contract conditions. The contract may also be terminated for breach of contractual obligations, persistent unsatisfactory perfor mance, non-payment of wages, non-deposit of statutory contributions, submission of false documents, una uthorized absence of deployed personnel, or violation of applicable laws and GeM conditions. In cases of serious misconduct, fraud, safety violations or other grave contractual breaches, the contract may be terminated in accordance with the applicable contractual provisions, after following the required pr ocedure. Upon termination, the service provider shall be entitled only to payment for satisfactory services actually r endered up to the effective date of termination, subject to verification and adjustment of recoveries, penal ties and other lawful dues. . 9. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 10. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 11. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 12. Service & Support The Service Provider is required to have at least 30 % of the required manpower on service provider’s payroll for at least one year. Necessary documents relating to such manpower will be uploaded by the bidder for verification of the buyer. Such manpower will be part of total manpower to be provided by the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this bid.
